question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**poison**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses how poison dart frogs' toxic excretions are used by indigenous people on weapons.
 
• The appropriate noun should relate to the substance that is used to coat arrows or blow darts, which in this case is poison.
 
• **"Poison" **fits well as it describes the toxic substance used on the tips of arrows and blow darts to make them lethal.
 
• Other options such as "bane," "malice," and "hate" do not fit in the context of the toxic substance used on weapons.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bane (कष्ट):** "Bane" refers to something causing harm or ruin, but it doesn't match the context of a toxic substance.
 
• **Malice (द्वेष): **"Malice" means the intention or desire to do evil, which doesn't fit the description of the toxic substance used for poisoning arrows.
 
• **Hate (नफ़रत):** "Hate" refers to an intense dislike or hostility, which is not related to the toxic substance in the context of the passage.
